notes.summary: Finite rational relatively nef models admit an absolute-value graph contraction retaining every central multiplicity. Their midpoint energy defect controls a raw absolute L1 moment. This proves a finite-model estimate, not an unbounded big-class operator.
notes.detailedSummary: On an SNC model with F=Σb_iE_i, the vertical quadratic form is a nonnegative weighted graph sum. Resolving the absolute value proves contraction of that form. For bounded relatively nef scalars on one actual nef bundle A, the midpoint defect δ_A satisfies n d_A/4^(n+1)≤δ_A≤n d_A/8. Finite slot changes then give an absolute moment estimate with exponent 2^−n, raw mass A^n, and the generic-value error retained. No volume denominator is used, including when A^n=0.
notes.text:
Retain every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field and smooth projective carrier of dimension n≥1. This result concerns bounded rational relatively nef model scalars on an actual nef rational bundle.

Let a smooth SNC equivariant model have central fiber F=Σ_i b_iE_i. For relatively nef actual slots Γ=N_1…N_(n−1), a vertical divisor D=Σ_i d_iE_i, and a_i=d_i/b_i, put c_ij=b_ib_j(E_iE_jΓ). Since O(F)|E_i is trivial, Σ_j b_j(E_iE_jΓ)=0. For i≠j, the SNC stratum E_iE_j is effective and the slots restrict to nef bundles, so c_ij≥0. Expanding D²Γ and replacing diagonal terms with these zero-row identities gives
−D²Γ=Σ_{i<j}c_ij(a_i−a_j)².
Every central multiplicity and exceptional component remains.

The absolute value is an actual resolved model function. Clear D by q and choose C with q(CF±D) effective integral. Principalize O(−q(CF+D))+O(−q(CF−D)). If its resolved divisor is G, then CF−G/q has scalar C−min(C+f_D,C−f_D)=|f_D| at every original point. The ideal is the unit ideal away from the central fiber. On a dominating SNC model the normalized coefficients are |a_i|, with all new b_i retained. Apply the graph identity there and use ||a_i|−|a_j||≤|a_i−a_j|. Projection formula preserves the original quadratic form. Thus |||f_D|||²_Γ≤||f_D||²_Γ.

For bounded relatively nef ξ,η,ψ on one actual nef A, write T_ξ=(A,ξ), V_A=A^n, e_A(ξ)=T_ξ^(n+1)/(n+1), J_A(ξ)=ξ(v0)V_A−e_A(ξ), and d_A(ξ,η)=max_{j<n}Q_j, where Q_j=−(0,ξ−η)²T_ξ^jT_η^(n−1−j)≥0. Finite raw top measures have coefficient b_E(T_ψ|E)^n and mass V_A. These use finite intersection calculus, or G0 on fixed actual ample perturbations followed by a finite polynomial limit.

For S=(0,ξ−η), two telescoping sums give
T_η^(n+1)−T_ξ^(n+1)+(n+1)ST_η^n=−Σ_{j=0}^{n−1}(n−j)S²T_ξ^jT_η^(n−1−j).
The coefficient is n−j with precisely these factors. At η=0 this gives J_A(ξ)=Σ_j(n−j)||ξ||²_(T_ξ^jT_0^(n−1−j))/(n+1), hence J_A(ξ) is comparable to d_A(ξ,0) with dimension constants.

Set p(t)=e_A(η+t(ξ−η)). Then −p''(t)=nΣ_j binom(n−1,j)t^j(1−t)^(n−1−j)Q_j. Its midpoint defect δ_A is the integral against k(t)=min(t,1−t)/2. Since ∫k=1/8, δ_A≤n d_A/8. On [1/4,3/4], k≥1/8 and each monomial factor is at least 4^(1−n), so every Q_j coefficient is at least n/4^(n+1). This proves the lower bound. For n=1 the exact coefficient is 1/8.

The finite slot-change proof is as follows. The average τ=(ξ+η)/2 gives d_A(ξ,η) comparable to ||ξ−η||²_(T_τ^(n−1)). The corrected tangent remainder is comparable to d_A and convex in its first potential, so d_A is quasi-convex. For another ρ, put a=d_A(ξ,η), b=max(d_A(ξ,ρ),d_A(η,ρ)), and b_j=||ξ−η||²_(T_ρ^jT_τ^(n−1−j)). Then b_0≤C_n a and b_(n−1)≤4b. Replacing one slot, writing one occurrence of (0,ξ−η) as T_ξ−T_η, and applying Cauchy–Schwarz in the two nef products gives b_(j+1)−b_j≤C_n sqrt(b_j b); T_ξ,T_η≤2T_τ bounds the factors. If a≤b, induction gives b_j≤C_n a^(2^−j)b^(1−2^−j); otherwise use b_(n−1)≤4b. Applying this through a third potential gives d≤C_n b^β max(d,b)^(1−β), β=2^(1−n). Division when d≥b proves the quasi-triangle estimate. Averaging the desired nef slots and expanding their nonnegative quadratic forms consequently gives
||ξ−η||²_(T_ρ1…T_ρ(n−1))≤C_n d_A(ξ,η)^β max(J_A(ξ),J_A(η),J_A(ρ_l))^(1−β).
For n=1 this is the empty-slot seminorm identity.

Resolve g=|ξ−η| and telescope the n-th powers starting at j=0:
∫g d(MA_A(ψ)−V_Aδ_v0)=Σ_{j=0}^{n−1}(0,g)(0,ψ)T_ψ^jT_0^(n−1−j).
Cauchy–Schwarz, graph contraction, the slot estimate and the J identity bound each term. The midpoint lower bound replaces d_A by C_nδ_A. With α=2^−n and B_*=max(J_A(ξ),J_A(η),J_A(ψ)), the result is
∫|ξ−η| dMA_raw,A(ψ)≤|ξ(v0)−η(v0)|V_A+C_nδ_A^α J_A(ψ)^(1/2)B_*^(1/2−α).
For n=1 omit the exponent-zero last factor. If V_A=0, positivity already forces the top measure to vanish. There is no volume denominator.

Evidence: paper.tex, Sections 2–3. Complete pertinent finite proof units were independently retrieved from Boucksom–Jonsson, arXiv:1801.08229v4, renderer 2705–2789 and 2790–3107; saved local coordinates are LF1–85 and LF1–318. No unbounded ample estimate is applied to a big class. Run python3 rerun.py. checks.py verifies the polynomial in dimensions 1–12, all 78 midpoint coefficients in those dimensions, and all 125 triples in {−2,−1,0,1,2}³ on one graph with multiplicities (1,2,3) and edge weights (1/2,2/3,3/4). These are exhaustive finite checks for the specified inputs; they do not certify the all-dimension mathematical proof draft.

notes.summary: The uniform finite-model Taylor estimate is reconstructed from full section lattices and algebraic volume derivatives. An explicit smallness condition keeps both signed perturbations big near c=B/V. This does not construct the unbounded operator.
notes.detailedSummary: For every retained actual big rational L, model obstacles have a full-section volume intercept ℰ and finite positive raw derivative measures of mass V=vol(L). For nonpositive obstacles of cost≤B, the deficient measure at c>B/V is coefficientwise dominated by the full derivative, with lost mass≤B/c. Fixed signed model directions have a refinement-independent Taylor estimate. The proof retains fixed nef decompositions and imposes |t|‖h‖∞<(c−B/V)/2 along both signs. Genuine scalar closure and unbounded output identification remain separate obligations.
notes.text:
This reconstruction retains every algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, smooth integral projective X of dimension n≥1, and actual big rational L. Put V=vol_X(L)>0 and d=n+1. Ordinary section-volume asymptotics and BFJ algebraic positive products and volume differentiation are explicit external algebraic background.

On a smooth equivariant model Y→X×P¹, product away from zero, let F=Σb_EE and D be actual vertical rational Cartier. If aF≤D≤bF, divisor comparison gives t^(−ma)R_m[t]⊂Λ_m⊂t^(−mb)R_m[t], R_m=H⁰(X,mL). Equivariance and an adapted basis of the finite homogeneous flag give Λ_m=⊕_j t^(−w_mj)k[t]s_mj, ma≤w_mj≤mb. Normal proper birational section descent retains the full original R_m. Gluing at infinity gives exactly
h⁰(Y,m(ρ_X*L+D+cF))=Σ_j max(w_mj+mc+1,0).
For sufficiently large c, section-volume limits give vol_Y(ρ_X*L+D+cF)/d=cV+ℰ(f_D). This actual full-section intercept is refinement invariant, monotone, V-translation equivariant and V-Lipschitz in the original sup norm. Volume-root concavity expanded at c→∞ proves its concavity; model density extends it to C(K).

For large c, algebraic volume differentiation gives
μ_D=Σ_E b_E⟨(ρ_X*L+D+cF)^n⟩·E δ_vE,
v_E=b_E^−1 ord_E|k(X).
Effective E directions have nonnegative derivatives. Differentiating the intercept in D+sE on a common eventual half-line proves each coefficient independent of large c. The F derivative gives mass V, and Dℰ_f(h)=∫hμ_D. On refinements, adding an effective exceptional divisor to a pulled bundle preserves sections because p_*O(rG)=O; its derivative coefficient is zero. Projection preserves the other coefficients. These are finite model measures.

Suppose f_D≤0 and ℰ(f_D)≥−B. Let g_D(c)=vol(ρ_X*L+D+cF)/d. The section formula makes it convex with g_D(0)=0, slope≤V, eventual expression cV+ℰ(f_D), and g_D(c)≥cV−B. Thus α_D(c) is big for c>B/V. Its derivative is the mass of μ_D,c, defined by the same positive-product formula at c. Convexity gives V−B/c≤g_D'(c)≤V.

Coefficientwise domination requires an additional argument. The exact trace gives
T_D(c)=ℰ(f_D)+cV−g_D(c)=lim_m n!m^(−n−1)Σ_j min(w_mj+mc,0).
The +1 discrepancy is O(dim R_m) and vanishes after scaling. Adding an effective vertical divisor increases every ordered weight by inclusion of filtration spaces. Each finite sum of min(weight+mc,0) therefore increases, and its limit does too. Differentiate T_D(c) in every effective E direction. The coefficient of μ_D−μ_D,c is nonnegative. Hence 0≤μ_D,c≤μ_D and its positive tail has mass≤B/c. No multilinearity of big positive products is assumed.

Fix h=f_H on one determination Z and an actual ample T there. Pull T,H back to any refinement carrying D. Put γ=ρ_X*L+cF, α=α_D(c), κ=d(cV−B)>0, and M=d⟨γ^n⟩·T. Since D≤0, α≤γ in psef order and vol(α)≥κ. Along α−rT while big, its volume loss is bounded by rM. Thus α−r₀T stays big for r₀=κ/[2(M+1)]; a first earlier exit would contradict continuity and the remaining positive volume. These constants depend on the fixed determination, not its refinements.

Choose a with aT±H nef and λ=a/r₀. Then λα±H are psef. For |s|λ<1/2, positive-product order gives
(1−λ|s|)^n⟨α^n⟩≤⟨(α+sH)^n⟩≤(1+λ|s|)^n⟨α^n⟩.
Decompose H into the two fixed nef tests H₁=aT+H, H₂=aT before pairing. Their pairings are bounded by ⟨γ^n⟩·H_l. This bounds deficient derivative variation by K_c|s| uniformly over obstacles and refinements, and integration gives an O(t²) estimate for g_D+tH(c).

For the full derivative put H₀=‖h‖∞. At parameter s use the nonpositive obstacle f_D+sh−|s|H₀ and time c_s=c+|s|H₀. Its actual cost is≤B_s=B+2V|s|H₀. Choose t_c≤1, |t|λ<1/2, and, for H₀>0, |t|H₀<(c−B/V)/2. Then c_s>B_s/V along both signed paths. Using only B+2VH₀ would not justify bigness when c is near B/V. The deficient class is exactly α+sH. Full derivative measures are invariant under scalar shifts, and their positive tails are≤B_s/c_s≤(B+2VH₀)/c. Integrate this derivative and replace the initial deficient derivative by μ_D at cost |t|H₀B/c. The result is
|ℰ(f_D+th)−ℰ(f_D)−t∫hμ_D|≤K_ct²/2+|t|H₀(2B+2VH₀)/c.
The finite intercept is C¹ along the path because a common sufficiently large time twist realizes it in actual big classes. Both signs are covered. The limit order is fixed c, then t→0, then c→∞.

Evidence: paper.tex, Section 4. Independently retrieved complete BFJ v2 units are renderer 310–441 and 445–545, saved local LF1–132 and LF1–101; its field statement is renderer 147. The pinned version is arXiv:math/0608260v2, posted 4 September 2007. Run python3 rerun.py. An exact margin check with V=B=H₀=1 and c=11/10 shows s=1/5 violates c_s>B_s/V, while s=1/100 satisfies it. This illustrates the repair without certifying the volume proof. Original all-E1 derivatives and operator conclusions still require genuine scalar and output foundations.

notes.summary: Conditional on explicitly unproved genuine scalar and moving foundations, the absolute midpoint estimate completes the target-approximation route to actual attainment and every-solution uniqueness for the outer map. Full original P16.5 remains unproved.
notes.detailedSummary: The antecedent package retains the literal all-point single FS-net cone, original compactness and envelopes, entire outer full-section E1 energy, contraction and divisor poles, target-independent outputs, and finite-list moving compatibility. Under it, n2 proves output approximation before attainment. A raw trace injection retains (min f)(V−A_m^n) and transfers n1's midpoint estimate. Small objective midpoint defects force divisorial convergence; finite supporting planes exclude an energy jump; the resulting absolute target estimate controls the varying target integrals. Whole planes extend, and divisorial probes separate every solution. The antecedent package, genuine unbounded mixed independence and strict Borel comparison are not proved.
notes.text:
This theorem is CONDITIONAL for the entire retained big rational-bundle domain. It uses n1 and n2 and the following unproved original-carrier package, not historical manuscript claims.

S1: The literal all-point single decreasing FS-net cone on varying actual bundles is convex, finite-max closed and decreasing closed at finite generic endpoints. Its normalized divisorial topology is compact. Genuine envelopes exist for usc obstacles with genuine minorants. R=P_θ(0) is genuine, R(v0)=0, and normalized u≤R≤0.
S2: E(u)=inf_{f∈C(K),f≥u}ℰ(f) on the whole cone is concave, monotone, weakly usc and decreasing-net continuous, E(R)=0, E(u+c)=E(u)+cV, and E(P_θ(f))=ℰ(f). Its entire actual E1 space is {E>−∞}. Continuous-obstacle ℰ is the full original section trace. Every normalized E1 function has nonpositive rational model majorants f_i↓u with f_i(v0)=0 and envelopes a_i↓u, energies decreasing to E(u). At fixed t their perturbed envelopes and energies decrease to P_θ(u+th). Outer usc energy agrees with envelope energy.
S3: An actual Kodaira identity L=aA+E₀ has A ample, E₀ effective, Z=E₀^an and U=K minus Z. A normalized actual w_Z∈E1 is −∞ on Z. Genuine contraction satisfies B((1−r)R+ru)≤C₀r²B(u), B=−E, with dimension constant C₀≥1.
M1: A target-independent map M on all actual E1 has positive original Radon outputs of raw mass V, constant invariance, M(P(f_D))=μ_D from n2, canonical weak convergence M(a_i)→M(u), and zero mass on Z.
M2: Every fixed finite list of nonpositive normalized model obstacles has full-system common actual moving data p_m*L=A_m+T_m, mA_m generated, mT_m effective, and bounded relatively nef ψ_m,D on that same A_m. The actual identities are φ_m,D=q_Tm+ψ_m,D and φ_m,0=q_Tm. In cofinal nonempty divisibility degrees, A_m^n→V, e_Am(ψ_m,D)→E(P(f_D)), ψ_m,D(v0)→0, and pushed auxiliary raw top measures→μ_D. Physical stages are original envelope minorants. The bounded nef trace equals the finite intersection energy. Multiplication by s_(ℓT_m) injects H⁰(X_m,ℓA_m) into the full original H⁰(X,ℓL). No physical polar stage is asserted to be original E1.

Rational divisorial testing suffices: along t ord_E, each defining FS stage is a finite maximum of affine functions of t>0. Its endpoint is convex and finite by actual ample embedding, hence continuous. Rational equality or order extends to all real scalings, after which G0 determination applies. No countability assumption is added.

Here is the continuation under these conditions. For f∈C(K), W_m(f;s)=inf_K(mf−log‖s‖) defines a finite closed-endpoint filtration of the full section space. Adapted-basis stages φ_m,f use floored weights, are basis independent by the ultrametric inequality, and increase in divisibility order. For h_i↓P(f) on actual B_i, fix rational t∈(0,1) and ε>0. Compact nested closed sets give a tail h_i<f+ε on all K. The actual bundle L−(1−t)B_i−t(L−aA) is eventually ample. Tensor its weight-zero generating system to obtain the minorant (1−t)(h_i−ε)+t(q_E₀−C) on L, C≥‖f‖∞. On U take i to its endpoint, then t→0, then ε→0. Section powers dominate real-weight minorants with flooring error<1/(mℓ). Thus P(f)=sup φ_m,f on U. It is finite and continuous there, and stages converge uniformly on compact subsets. R−P(f) is bounded continuous on U.

For finite Radon ν missing Z and directed increasing nonnegative continuous costs c_i on U, the integral of their supremum equals the supremum of their integrals. Their open superlevels cover the supremum's superlevels; any compact subset has a finite subcover dominated by one index. Inner regularity identifies the masses. A common index handles finitely many thresholds; lower layer-cake sums and truncation prove the integral assertion. Arbitrary measurable-net monotone convergence is not used.

An intrinsic target has mass V, excludes {R=−∞}, integrates every actual E1 relative cost I_ν(u)=∫(R−u), and has D_ν=sup_normalized(E(u)+I_ν(u))<∞. No absolute reference integrability is imposed. The divisor pole w_Z implies ν(Z)=0. Directed cost integration and decreasing energy continuity make the objective supremum equal the model-envelope supremum. Choose model u_k within ε_k=1/k. Contraction at r=1/(2C₀) gives I_ν(u)≤B(u)/2+2C₀D_ν, hence B(u_k)≤Q_ν=4C₀D_ν+2.

The whole fixed-increment estimate n2 passes to every actual E1 base through canonical majorants at fixed t with unchanged constants. Divide with both signs, let t→0 at fixed c, then c→∞. Uniform model density gives continuous derivatives. Perturb the actual base u_k+th, taking z_k,t=P(u_k+th). Its energy is finite and z_k,t≤u_k+th gives E(z_k,t)−E(u_k)−t∫hν≤ε_k. Both increment signs imply |∫h(M(u_k)−ν)|≤ε_k/t+K_ct/2+A_h(Q_ν)/c. Taking k→∞, then t→0, then c→∞ proves output convergence before attainment, reconstructing the main ROOT199 bridge.

Fix model envelopes a=P(f_H), b=P(f_J), w=P(f_D). The common moving physical midpoint q_Tm+(ψ_m,H+ψ_m,J)/2 is≤(a+b)/2. Fix one original continuous f≥(a+b)/2. The actual section injection gives its original filtration trace at least the auxiliary midpoint trace plus quotient rank times ℓ min f. At supported zeros the original section-weight expression is +∞ and cannot lower its infimum. First let ℓ→∞ with m,f fixed:
ℰ(f)≥e_Am((ψ_m,H+ψ_m,J)/2)+(min_K f)(V−A_m^n).
This generally negative missing-rank term is retained at finite m. Only after m→∞ for this fixed finite f does it vanish; finally take the outer infimum. Hence limsup_m δ_Am(ψ_m,H,ψ_m,J)≤δ(a,b), where δ(a,b)=E((a+b)/2)−(E(a)+E(b))/2.

Apply n1. Generic errors vanish and J factors tend to the original costs. The changing absolute quotient is bounded by the fixed obstacle difference and converges uniformly on compact subsets of U. Its integral passes to μ_D using a fixed continuous cutoff: first choose a compact subset carrying almost all limiting mass, then the collar, then the degree and measure indices. The omitted mass passes through that fixed cutoff. This yields, with α=2^−n,
∫|a−b|M(w)≤C_nδ(a,b)^α B(w)^(1/2)max(B(a),B(b),B(w))^(1/2−α).
It holds first for model pairs at model outputs, then at arbitrary outputs by M1. Passing along target-output approximants gives the same bound at ν with B(w) replaced by Q_ν.

To justify every unbounded test, take model majorants v_j↓v. Since δ(R,v_j)≤B(v)/2, the model estimate uniformly bounds ∫(R−v_j)M(w). Directed cost integration proves integrability of R−v and relative L1 convergence. At a prescribed target the same convergence follows from its integrability condition. Pass the two test nets separately in L1 and their midpoint energies decreasingly to extend both estimates to all actual pairs. Differences are defined where both relative costs are finite, a full-measure set, and set to zero on its null complement; two infinite values are never subtracted. Outputs have finite intrinsic dual energy as well: the moment bound is≤C_n sqrt(B(v)B(w)) when B(v)≥B(w), and≤C_nB(w) otherwise.

Finite whole planes require only fixed divisorial support. Concavity and n2's derivative give E(v)≤ℰ(f_D)+∫(v−f_D)μ_D by continuous majorants at that support. E(P(f_D))=ℰ(f_D) and P(f_D)≤f_D force the nonnegative contact integral to vanish. Thus E(v)≤E(a)+∫(v−a)M(a) for every actual test at every model base.

Near maximality gives 0≤δ(u_i,u_j)≤(ε_i+ε_j)/2, since target integration is linear. Every raw divisorial probe Vδ_z is intrinsic: common actual ample embedding and G0 compactness uniformly bound normalized u(z) below; R(z) is finite. Its relative integrals and dual supremum are finite without a Dirac inverse equation. The target absolute estimate makes u_k(z) Cauchy. Genuine compactness and determination yield one actual normalized weak limit u, and energy usc gives finite energy.

Finite planes and the absolute output estimate make E(u_k) Cauchy, with limit e≤E(u). For fixed i, μ_i=M(u_i) has finite divisorial support, so
∫|u−u_i|μ_i=lim_j∫|u_j−u_i|μ_i≤C_(n,Qν)ε_i^α.
Its finite plane implies E(u)≤E(u_i)+Cε_i^α. Sending i→∞ excludes the jump: E(u)=e. Concavity and energy usc at (u_i+u)/2 give δ(u_i,u)→0. The full target estimate then gives ∫|u_i−u|ν→0, controlling the formerly varying target integrals. The objective is actually attained at u; both continuous stationarity signs identify M(u)=ν.

Finally, fixed genuine tests pass along weakly convergent bounded-cost output families. For v_j↓v, δ(v_j,v)≤(E(v_j)−E(v))/2 makes their absolute errors uniform; bounded relative integrals pass by fixed collars. Extend model planes along a_i↓u; their error ∫|a_i−u|M(a_i) tends to zero. This gives whole planes E(v)≤E(u)+∫(v−u)M(u). Every solution maximizes the objective. Two normalized solutions have δ(a,b)=0; divisorial probes force equality there, and G0 determination gives all-point equality, restoring uniqueness modulo constants.

This proves actual attainment and every-solution separation for the conditional outer map. It does not establish S–M, identify all unbounded mixed or changing physical approximations, or prove strict Borel locality/comparison. The optional ROOT199 below-approximant passage is valid if continuous a_η≤R−v with uniform output error are supplied: extend the nonnegative cost by zero on Z, apply nonnegative lsc Portmanteau to its error, then pass continuous integrals. Existence of these approximants remains an additional assumption in that optional route; this attainment argument does not require it. Artifact: paper.tex, Sections 5–10. Run python3 rerun.py. Compilation does not certify these conditional mathematical deductions.

notes.detailedSummary: For every actual numerically trivial rational L in the retained domain, the single-net numerical cone consists exactly of constants, including nontorsion Pic0 bundles. Raw energy and operator are zero; the sole positive target is zero, with uniqueness modulo constants. This does not cover nonzero zero-volume classes. The positive-volume continuation remains conditional, and genuine unbounded mixed independence and strict Borel comparison are unresolved. Exact input preservation, source maps, finite arithmetic and two-pass compilation succeeded without mathematical certification.
notes.text:
The full original P16.5 is NOT solved. The unchanged task and family, completion criteria, exact assignment, complete grants, unreviewed supplied bodies, and all their positive-volume and additional zero-volume statements remain preserved.

One additional zero-volume theorem is independent of n3's conditional package. Let actual rational L be numerically trivial on any retained smooth integral projective n-fold, n≥1, including nontorsion Pic0 bundles. Use the varying-actual-bundle single-net convention and reference zero. For rational ε>0, actual L+εA is ample; its weight-zero generating system is zero everywhere. These constant scalars give one defining net for zero and its shifts. Conversely normalize u∈PSH(0) at v0 to zero. Integer tensoring gives mu∈PSH(0) for every positive integer m. Embed each in the same actual ample cone. G0 compactness gives −C_z≤mu(z)≤0 independently of m at each rational divisorial z, so u(z)=0. Along divisorial rays the endpoint of the affine-max stages is finite convex and continuous; rational equality extends to real equality. G0 determination gives u=0 everywhere. Thus PSH(0)=R.

Raw ample perturbations on constants have mass ε^nA^n→0 and energy cε^nA^n→0. Positivity bounds each continuous integral by its sup norm times that mass. Their unique raw limit is zero; raw energy is zero on the entire classified cone, E1(0)=R, and the operator is zero. The sole positive mass-zero target is literally zero; solutions form one class modulo constants. Comparison and zero derivatives are immediate. No zero mass is normalized to a probability.

This is precisely numerical zero, not every pseudoeffective zero-volume class. On P1×P1, nonzero nef L=p1*O(1) has volume zero and both zero and a nonconstant bounded generated-system scalar with sections z1,z0 and weights 0,−1. Along the branch toward z1=0 it equals max(−s,−1). Tensor both into L+εO(1,1). Their raw positive masses are 2ε(1+ε)→0, so both top limits vanish although their potentials differ by more than a constant. This obstructs naive uniqueness on that entire zero-mass cone; it does not disprove the positive-volume task.

The unresolved positive-volume assertions are: independently establish all of S1–S3 for the literal single-net cone and entire actual E1 space; establish M1–M2 and every moving/weak-output compatibility; identify the outer map with the genuine original operator for all admissible simultaneous unbounded weighted and mixed approximations; prove strict-winning locality and strict Borel comparison, including required nonalgebraic negligible-set nullness.
